items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: Now, going back to drummers that I worked with, too, I think Sonny Greer was the most colorful.

ctx.x: I spent a great deal of happiness in my life with Osie. But this is your story. I wanted you to talk about these things.

Yes. Now, going back to drummers that I worked with, too, I think Sonny Greer was the most colorful. Sonny Greer wasn't a swing drummer, actually, but colorful. He could paint pictures. He could create feelings.
